groups.title: Color looks: pick one, then set amount and its own two controls
Film and black and white looks

subgraphs.name: Bright and Airy
subgraphs.description: A light, clean look: lifted shadows, soft highlights, pastel greens and a warm glow on skin. Suits portraits, weddings, interiors and lifestyle pictures.

subgraphs.name: Moody Film
subgraphs.description: Dark and muted with faded blacks, quiet greens, teal shadows and warm highlights on a colour negative, with grain and a vignette.

subgraphs.name: Teal and Orange
subgraphs.description: The blockbuster grade: teal shadows against warm skin and highlights, greens pulled toward teal, finished on a cinema print film.

subgraphs.name: Golden Hour
subgraphs.description: Late sun: warm amber light through the highlights and midtones, a gentle glow round bright areas and lively colour.

subgraphs.name: Kodachrome Classic
subgraphs.description: Rich reds, deep shadows and cyan skies on a warm slide film, with a slight vignette.

subgraphs.name: Retro Film Lab
subgraphs.description: A full analog finish: the generated look calmed, consumer film colour and grain, halation, a light leak, dust and a vignette.

subgraphs.name: Vintage Instant
subgraphs.description: An old instant print: faded colour and a warm cast, soft corners, a dark edge and a little dust.

subgraphs.name: Classic Black and White
subgraphs.description: Gritty street black and white: a high speed stock printed through a yellow filter on warm fibre paper with a touch of selenium.
